name: sim_q_nonmonotonicity_in_n_sweep

pytorch.reason: Random H sweep (P1) uses torch for reproducible draws

pyg.reason: probe operates on density matrices; graph-level message passing architectures are outside this probe's scope

z3.reason: N1: UNSAT proof that Q_{N+1} > Q_N is impossible when H_{N+1}=0.3 < 1

cvc5.reason: z3 sufficient for all separability and product-form UNSAT proofs in this sim

sympy.reason: N2: symbolic proof that sign(Q*h - Q) is determined by h vs 1

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra encodes geometric rotors; Q-product sweep is scalar arithmetic, no spinor or rotor structure present

geomstats.reason: Geomstats provides Riemannian manifold operations; Q non-monotonicity depends on scalar H_i values, not curvature or geodesics

e3nn.reason: SO(3)-equivariant neural networks are outside this probe's scope; probe uses direct operator application

rustworkx.reason: probe uses matrix operations rather than graph traversal; rustworkx is outside this probe's scope

xgi.reason: XGI handles hypergraph higher-order interactions; Q product over ordered shells has pairwise-sequential structure, no hyperedges required

toponetx.reason: TopoNetX provides cell complex topology; the monotonicity question is purely over the real number line, not a topological space

gudhi.reason: probe uses analytic methods; persistent homology library is outside this probe's scope

P1.name: P1_random_H_sweep
P1.interpretation: Both directions occur; non-monotonicity is value-dependent

N1.name: N1_z3_unsat_increase_impossible
N1.interpretation: UNSAT confirms Q_{N+1} > Q_N is impossible when H_{N+1}=0.3 < 1 and Q_N > 0

N2.name: N2_sympy_sign_proof
N2.interpretation: sign(Q*h - Q) = sign(h - 1); structural, not value-of-Q-dependent

B1.name: B1_zero_shell_collapses_Q
B1.interpretation: Zero-in-subshell collapses Q regardless of N or position

divergence_log: Q non-monotonicity in N is value-dependent (H_i <> 1 determines direction); the zero-in-subshell property is N-independent and structural. Q_10 < Q_9 in the N-ladder because specific shell H values multiply in factors < 1.
